candidates.name: NEAR Protocol
candidates.thesis: First large L1 with opt-in NIST ML-DSA-65 account signatures live on mainnet (July 2026); rotatable access keys make migration cheap.

claims.claim: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) transaction signatures and access keys
claims.note: Protocol v85, neard 2.13. Opt-in; Ed25519/secp256k1 not deprecated. NEP-645 still marked Draft.
Explicitly out of scope of the first milestone; consensus stays classical.
Gated separately from the transaction feature in nearcore docs; activation on mainnet not confirmed in the 2.13 notes.

claims.claim: Quantum-safe custody of other chains' assets via Chain Signatures / Intents
claims.note: Chain Signatures MPC and the destination chains remain elliptic-curve; only the NEAR account key is PQ.

risks: PQ is opt-in: most accounts stay Ed25519 until users rotate
Consensus/validator crypto still classical
Chain fees are small (~$1.3M/yr DefiLlama) so the token has no revenue support; it is a narrative + L1 adoption bet
Inflationary staking issuance (~5%/yr nominal, part burned via fees)
thesisBreak: ML-DSA rolled back or a critical bug found in the PQ path
No validator/consensus PQ work shipped by end-2027 (roadmap slips)
Price makes a new 1y low after a sentiment 'euphoric' reading (narrative exhausted)

broad.caveat: survivor-biased: only coins still listed on Binance today

caveats: Weekly entries overlap (52 per year share most of the same forward window): treat episodes, not weekly n, as the real sample size.
Survivorship: delisted coins are missing, which flatters every strategy.
Price only: no fees, slippage, taxes; cash earns 0%.
Rule-only leaves cash idle when no drawdown comes (investedPct < 100%); in a straight bull run it lags DCA and lump sum (see ZEC).
2023+ test period is a single market cycle.

snapshot.src: CoinGecko /coins/venice-token; DefiLlama /summary/fees/venice dailyHoldersRevenue (= on-chain buy-and-burn only); derived figures computed from those two

claims.claim: On-chain VVV buy-and-burn ~$985K in the last 30 days (~$12M/yr annualized)
claims.note: DefiLlama holders revenue 30d $985,346; annualized x365/30 = $11.99M. DefiLlama counts only the on-chain burn; subscription/API/DIEM revenue settles off-chain and is excluded.

claims.claim: Stake VVV -> sVVV -> lock to mint DIEM; 1 staked DIEM = $1/day API credit
claims.note: Credit refreshes 00:00 UTC, no rollover; DIEM supply target raised 38,000 -> 40,000 (Aug-Sep 2026). DIEM contract 0xF4d97F2da56e8c3098f3a8D538DB630A2606a024; staking 0x321b7ff75154472B18EDb199033fF4D116F340Ff.

claims.claim: Emissions cut to 2M VVV/yr (from 14M at Jan 2025 TGE)
claims.note: 2M/yr = 4.1% of circulating, ~$55.5M/yr at $27.75 vs ~$12M/yr burned (~432K VVV at today's price): still net inflationary. 100% of emissions go to stakers.

claims.claim: Venice $100M+ annualized revenue reaches token holders
claims.note: The $100M+ ARR (Aug 2026; founder claims >$150M Oct 14) belongs to Venice the company, which raised equity separately ($65M Series A at a $1B valuation). Equity and token are separate: holders get only the burn (~$12M/yr), not the revenue.

watchlist.whyNotYet: Market cap is ~112x annualized on-chain burns. Price is only ~20% off the ATH ($34.53, 2026-09-21); the Long Book entry rule wants a 70% drawdown from the 1y high (buy-zone ~$10.36 at today's 1y high) and that rule is itself unproven out-of-sample. No entry yet.
risks: Holders get the burn only, not the company's revenue (equity and token separate)
Emissions (2M/yr) still exceed burns in token terms
Terminal rug scan 2026-10-21: watch 40/100: mint authority live, 58% of supply in staking/vesting/lock contracts, creator/dev wallet flagged by scanner
Burn rate depends on Venice keeping its discretionary/programmatic burn policy
revisitIf: Daily close at or below the Long Book buy-zone (70% under the 1y high)
Annualized on-chain burns rise enough that mcap / burns falls well below today's ~112x
Burns exceed emissions (net deflationary in tokens)
